{"text": "import json
from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Pool 48 libraries", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # labware
    tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    dest_tube = tuberack["A1"]
    
    # define liquids
    lib_names = [f"library {i}" for i in range(1, 49)]
    liquids = {}
    for i, name in enumerate(lib_names, start=1):
        liq = protocol.define_liquid(name=name, description=f"Library {i}", display_color="#FF0000")
        liquids[name] = liq
        # place each library in plate wells A1..D12
        well = plate.wells()[i-1]  # zero-indexed
        well.load_liquid(liq, volume=20)  # starting volume 20 µL
    
    # water or buffer not needed
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack])
    
    # transfer 5 µL from each library well to destination tube
    for src_well, lib_name in zip(plate.wells()[:48], lib_names):
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, src_well)
        p20.dispense(5, dest_tube)
        p20.drop_tip()
        "}

{"text": "import json
from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Pool 48 libraries", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # labware
    tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    dest_tube = tuberack["A1"]  # destination for pooled libraries
    
    # define liquids
    lib_names = [f"library {i}" for i in range(1, 49)]
    liquids = {}
    for i, name in enumerate(lib_names, start=1):
        liq = protocol.define_liquid(name=name, description=f"Library {i}", display_color="#FF0000")
        liquids[name] = liq
        # place each library in plate wells A1..D12 (first 48 wells)
        well = plate.wells()[i-1]  # zero-indexed
        well.load_liquid(liq, volume=50)  # starting volume 50 µL to keep tip submerged
    
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack])
    
    # transfer 5 µL from each library well to destination tube
    for src_well, lib_name in zip(plate.wells()[:48], lib_names):
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, src_well)
        p20.dispense(5, dest_tube)
        p20.drop_tip()
    
    # mix the pooled tube to ensure homogeneity using p20 (max 20 µL)
    p20.pick_up_tip()
    p20.mix(12, 20, dest_tube)  # 12 repetitions, 20 µL each = 240 µL total moved
    p20.drop_tip()"}

   line 34:  p20.mix(12, 20, dest_tube)  # 12 repetitions, 20 µL each = 240 µL total moved

   concentration you calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits the
   error.
   Affected: tube A1 in slot 3.

    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
